description: Empirical electrical-power vs time lookup for a Pu-238 GPHS-RTG. P_elec(t) = P_thermal_0*exp(-ln2*t/t_half) * eta_teg(t), where eta_teg degrades linearly ~0.1%/yr. Combines isotope decay heat drop and thermoelectric efficiency fade.
source: Bennett (2006) Acta Astronautica; El-Genk & Saber (2005) Energy Convers. Mgmt.; NASA GPHS-RTG spec

isotope.note: Plutonium-238 alpha emitter (reused from EC223 F1a)

eta_teg_0.note: Initial TEG conversion efficiency (reused from F1a)

lookup.note: Breakpoints: mission time (years) -> net electrical power (W). Reflects both thermal decay and TEG efficiency fade; reaches 0 W near 65 yr as eta_teg -> 0.
